#### 1. spastic paraplegia 72b, autosomal recessive  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.733)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:17975)

**Proposed mechanism:** REEP2 (HGNC:17975) —DISRUPTS→ Endoplasmic Reticulum organization (GO:0005789); Endoplasmic Reticulum organization (GO:0005789) —LEADS_TO→ Spasticity (HP:0001257); Endoplasmic Reticulum organization (GO:0005789) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Endoplasmic Reticulum organization (GO:0005789) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal vocalization (HP:0011255). Loss-of-function mutations in REEP2 disrupt endoplasmic reticulum organization, leading to a shared set of neurological and developmental phenotypes, including spasticity, intellectual disability, and abnormal vocalizations, which manifest as distinct disease entities.
